body_markdown:
*WPP to leverage Kyndryl's Agentic AI Framework throughout its operations* *Kyndryl names WPP as its preferred global marketing partner*


LONDON


, Oct. 6, 2026


/PRNewswire/ --[Kyndryl](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4789627-1&h=950050038&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.kyndryl.com%2Fgb%2Fen&a=Kyndryl) (NYSE: KD), a leading provider of mission-critical enterprise technology services, and[WPP](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4789627-1&h=417738563&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wpp.com%2Fen&a=WPP) , the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands, today announced an expanded agreement under which they will redefine the traditional customer-supplier relationship.


The expanded partnership focuses on three key areas: the transformation of WPP's business platforms and support model, an expanded marketing partnership naming WPP as Kyndryl's preferred global marketing partner, and joint go-to-market initiatives to drive customer growth through modernization and core business transformation.


"This partnership redefines the traditional customer-supplier relationship. Kyndryl will help WPP accelerate enterprise transformation through AI-enabled operations, platform modernisation and a simpler technology landscape, while WPP will support Kyndryl's growth through an expanded marketing partnership and joint go-to-market innovation," said Dominic Shine, Chief Information Officer, WPP. "Together, we are investing in each other's success, creating a relationship built on shared outcomes, trust and long-term value creation."


**Business platform transformation for AI-powered modernization** The[Kyndryl Agentic AI Framework](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4789627-1&h=1801857003&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.kyndryl.com%2Fgb%2Fen%2Fartificial-intelligence%2Fagentic-ai-framework%3Futm_medium%3Dpaid-search%26utm_source%3Dgoogle%26utm_content%3Dother%26utm_term%3Dagentic%2520ai%2520framework%26utm_campaign%3DKIXWW%26gad_source%3D1%26gad_campaignid%3D19928045730%26gbraid%3D0AAAAArA7SN8uPULjfq8c2UGvj86bJ_2Li%26gclid%3DEAIaIQobChMIvZXs5ObrlQMVOpJQBh092h3OEAAYASAAEgLsQ_D_BwE&a=Kyndryl+Agentic+AI+Framework) will be applied to help modernize WPP's application estate with intelligent support operations, faster issue resolution, and reduced technical complexity. This will help enable WPP to provide more flexible technology operations in support of its[Elevate28 strategy](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4789627-1&h=2390026402&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wpp.com%2Fen%2Fnews%2F2026%2F02%2Fstrategy-update-and-2025-preliminary-results&a=Elevate28+strategy) , which aims to modernize its enterprise technology environment to help it become a simpler, more integrated, AI-powered company.


"By combining enterprise modernization, AI-enabled operations and customer growth capabilities, we are creating a blueprint that helps WPP transform and innovate faster to drive meaningful outcomes," said Jonathan Ingram, President, Kyndryl UKI. "This is helping us unlock new sources of joint value and shared success."


The new operating model will bring together workplace, cloud, infrastructure and enterprise services under a common, automated operating model. By retiring legacy applications and accelerating adoption of strategic enterprise platforms, WPP expects to realise cost savings and efficiencies over time. A portion of these savings will be reinvested into projects which deliver further IT simplification, productivity and operational benefit and, will be further enhanced by the use of[Kyndryl Bridge](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4789627-1&h=700641985&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.kyndryl.com%2Fgb%2Fen%2Fservices%2Fplatform%3Futm_medium%3Dpaid-search%26utm_source%3Dgoogle%26utm_content%3Dother%26utm_term%3Dkyndryl%2520bridge%26utm_campaign%3DKNAWW%26gad_source%3D1%26gad_campaignid%3D19935988459%26gbraid%3D0AAAAArA7SN8T53lRE2vVtlRjL9McQjwJP%26gclid%3DEAIaIQobChMIo-iEmuHrlQMVL5dQBh0BiDeXEAAYASAAEgIw7vD_BwE&a=Kyndryl+Bridge) , an AI-powered, open-integration digital business platform to integrate, observe and orchestrate across its entire technology environment.


**Global marketing partnership for innovation and growth** Kyndryl has named WPP as its preferred Marketing partner, expanding the existing relationship beyond Media, Brand, and Creative Strategy to encompass a broader portfolio of high-value digital, experiential, and integrated marketing capabilities, alongside the enablement of an AI-powered Marketing Operating System built on[WPP Open](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4789627-1&h=1074611668&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wpp.com%2Fen%2Fopen&a=WPP+Open) , WPP's pioneering agentic marketing platform. This expanded partnership across Enterprise Technology, Go-to-Market, and Marketing creates a powerful platform for innovation, growth, and business transformation for both WPP and Kyndryl.


**Strengthened joint Go-to-Market initiatives** Kyndryl Consult and WPP Enterprise Solutions (previously VML Enterprise Solutions) will also continue to strengthen joint go-to-market efforts, previously[announced in 2025](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4789627-1&h=200638046&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.kyndryl.com%2Fgb%2Fen%2Fabout-us%2Fnews%2F2025%2F09%2Fvml-global-partnership&a=announced+in+2025) , to drive client growth through modernization and core business transformation by reimagining how customers engage with brands through the power of AI, data and emerging technology.


**About Kyndryl** Kyndryl (NYSE: KD) is a leading provider of mission-critical enterprise technology services, offering advisory, implementation and managed service capabilities to thousands of customers in more than 60 countries. As the world's largest IT infrastructure services provider, the company designs, builds, manages and modernizes the complex information systems that the world depends on every day. For more information, visit[www.kyndryl.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4789627-1&h=2812558696&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.kyndryl.com%2Fgb%2Fen&a=www.kyndryl.com) .


**About WPP** WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. The company unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and its agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit[wpp.com.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4789627-1&h=394536314&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wpp.com%2F&a=wpp.com.)
